title: Extension by zero on a localized site is exact
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a Grothendieck site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $W$ be an object. Give $\mathcal C/W$ the localized topology, with coverings whose underlying families cover in $\mathcal C$. For the abelian sheaf categories [def-sp-abelian], the extension-by-zero functor $j_{W!}:\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C/W)\to\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ is exact: for every short exact sequence $0\to F_1\to F_2\to F_3\to0$ on $\mathcal C/W$, the sequence $0\to j_{W!}F_1\to j_{W!}F_2\to j_{W!}F_3\to0$ is exact on $\mathcal C$.

proof.text: The explicit presheaf map is DirectSum.map on the section homomorphisms, by extensionality on direct-sum injections. Presheaf evaluation preserves monomorphisms, which in AddCommGrpCat are precisely injective homomorphisms. DirectSum.map_injective proves preservation of monomorphisms by presheaf extension by zero.
The sheaf inclusion and sheafification preserve finite limits, hence monomorphisms. Compose these with the presheaf functor of Step 1 to obtain monomorphism preservation by siteExtensionByZeroSheaf.

The explicit sheaf functor and sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback are both left adjoint to restriction. The existing presheaf adjunction gives the first adjunction; sheafAdjunctionContinuous gives the second. Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq gives their natural isomorphism, and Functor.PreservesMonomorphisms.of_iso transfers Step 2.

Restriction is additive by sectionwise evaluation. Its left adjoint is additive by Adjunction.left_adjoint_additive and therefore preserves zero morphisms. It preserves colimits by Adjunction.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits. For a short exact complex S, the final map is a cokernel of the first; CokernelCofork.mapIsColimit maps this universal property to the chosen extension functor.

ShortComplex.exact_and_epi_g_iff_g_is_cokernel applied to the mapped cokernel gives exactness and an epimorphic final map. The first map is monic by Step 3. Construct ShortComplex.ShortExact from these properties.
